name: Bun cha ca tram
summary: Bún chả cá trắm uses Son River grass carp. The 13 June 2025 article describes fresh noodles, a strong dipping sauce, and herbs. The 20 May 2025 article describes a fried fish cake in a broth.
origin: Phong Nha, in two Quang Binh visitor portal articles, 20 May 2025 and 13 June 2025.
texture: The 13 June 2025 article says the carp flesh is firm and sweet.
howToEat: The 13 June 2025 article eats it with fresh rice noodles, a strong dipping sauce, and herbs.
The 20 May 2025 article describes a different bowl: a fried fish cake with noodles and broth. Both accounts stay.
A door, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Phong Nha. Neither article names a street. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bun cha ca tram — two Son River accounts
seoDescription: One 2025 article serves bún chả cá trắm with a dipping sauce. The 20 May article describes fried fish cake in broth. A price is Check on arrival.
